description: Source code for a metrics collection and management system used in the Dynamo component of PyTorch's compilation and runtime environment. It provides classes and functions for gathering, reporting, and managing metrics during compilation and execution phases, including context managers for nested metrics collection and specialized runtime metrics context.

classes.name: TopN
classes.description: Helper class for storing and retrieving the top N elements based on a metric value.

classes.name: MetricsContext
classes.description: Context manager for collecting and reporting metrics during compilation.

classes.name: RuntimeMetricsContext
classes.description: Context for collecting runtime metrics that are decoupled from compilation contexts.

methods.name: None add(self, key: Any, val: int)
methods.description: Adds a metric to the TopN heap, maintaining only the top N values.

methods.name: int __len__(self)
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the TopN heap.

methods.name: Iterator[tuple[Any,int]] __iter__(self)
methods.description: Iterates over the TopN elements, sorted in priority.

methods.name: MetricsContext.__enter__
methods.description: Initializes metrics recording when entering the context.

methods.name: MetricsContext.__exit__
methods.description: Handles cleanup and reporting when exiting the metrics context.

methods.name: MetricsContext.in_progress
methods.description: Checks if the context is currently active.

methods.name: MetricsContext.increment
methods.description: Increments a named metric by a specified value.

methods.name: MetricsContext.set
methods.description: Sets a metric to a specific value, raising if previously set.

methods.name: MetricsContext.set_key_value
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair inside a metric treated as a dictionary.

methods.name: MetricsContext.update_outer
methods.description: Updates metrics only at the outermost context level.

methods.name: MetricsContext.add_to_set
methods.description: Records a value as part of a set-based metric.

methods.name: MetricsContext.add_top_n
methods.description: Records a metric as a TopN set of values.

methods.name: RuntimeMetricsContext.increment
methods.description: Increments a runtime metric, optionally updating additional key-value metrics.

methods.name: RuntimeMetricsContext.finish
methods.description: Finalizes and reports gathered runtime metrics.
